title: Wonderfully Smoked American Pork Grill
description: A deliciously smoky American-style pork dish featuring tender, juicy meat and a sweet, caramelized crust. Perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder
ingredients.notes: preferably with a good fat cap

ingredients.name: Smoking wood chips (e.g., apple or cherry)

instructions: Preheat your grill to 225-250°F (110-120°C) for low and slow cooking.
In a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Rub the sugar mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork shoulder in a large zip-top plastic bag or a non-reactive container with a lid.
Add the smoking wood chips, olive oil, and rosemary leaves to the bag or container with the pork.
Seal the bag or cover the container and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Place the pork shoulder on the grill, closing the lid to trap the smoke and heat.
Smoke the pork for 4-5 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
If using, brush the pork with bourbon or whiskey during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Remove the pork from the grill and let it rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the pork with your choice of sides, such as coleslaw or baked beans.
